summary: pause_generation(mode="retract") now evicts every radix-cache component that is evictable after all retracted requests have dropped their locks, so a released prefix cannot be matched after resume. The correction covers standard full-KV radix caches and hybrid full/SWA/Mamba caches while leaving chunk-cache behavior unchanged.

tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before regression: 2 failures showed retract_all never queried or evicted the 37-token standard radix prefix or the full/SWA/Mamba hybrid components; the empty and chunk-cache boundary cases passed. Raw output: reports/j-0f0ccd912598/retract-tests-before.txt

37 tests passed plus 2 subtests. The regression inserted and locked a real four-token RadixCache prefix, simulated request unlock during retract_all, and verified a subsequent match returned zero tokens and the allocator received the freed segment. Independent standard, hybrid, empty-cache, and chunk-cache cases passed. Raw output: reports/j-0f0ccd912598/retract-tests-after.txt
No whitespace errors in the source and regression changes.

tests.command: rocm-smi --showproductname --showuniqueid --showmeminfo vram; prepared Python torch.cuda inventory
tests.what_was_measured: The assigned single GPU is an AMD Instinct MI350X with gfx950; Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 sees exactly one device. This was inventory only, not an issue-specific GPU execution. Raw output: reports/j-0f0ccd912598/gpu-inventory.txt

gpu_execution.evidence: The defect and regression are scheduler/radix ownership bookkeeping and execute deterministically on CPU. The assigned gfx950 was detected, but the prepared job has no Qwen3-4B/Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 weights, so no full-model weight-swap or semantic-output claim is made.

remaining_limitations: The reported Qwen3-4B to Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 weight-update sequence and its logprob/text divergence were not reproduced because those model weights are not present in the prepared runtime.
The deterministic regression validates radix ownership, physical allocator release, and post-retract prefix match invalidation; it does not validate model semantic accuracy.
Disaggregated prefill intentionally retains a live mid-chunk chunked request in the existing implementation; that documented stale-weight limitation remains outside this narrow fix.
No native C++ or FlyDSL source changed; native rebuild was not applicable.
